# Sedat Okutan

> Sedat Okutan is an independent software developer based in İzmir, Türkiye. He builds web platforms, online communities, developer tools and mobile games, handling everything from design and code to launch and community growth. okutan.org is his personal developer site (Turkish and English).

Contact: sedat@okutan.org — open to freelance work and collaboration, usually replies within 24 hours.

## Live projects

- [LaunchShots](https://launchshots.app/): Free, browser-based screenshot designer for the App Store and Google Play. 11 device frames, 25 languages, zoom callouts and annotations, store-ready ZIP export. No sign-up, no watermark. Built with JavaScript and Canvas.
- [Kelimeler: Online Kelime Oyunu](https://okutan.org/kelimeler/): Social, competitive online word game made for Turkish, on iPhone and Android: 60,000+ words, city battles across 81 provinces, daily puzzle and quick-play modes. The new version of his Android word game that reached a 4.8 rating on Google Play.
  - [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kelimeler-online-kelime-oyunu/id6775899635)
  - [Android](https://okutan.org/kelimeler/android.html)
  - [Support](https://okutan.org/kelimeler/support.html)
- [Oyunlar](https://okutan.org/oyunlar/): Games hub listing all of Sedat Okutan's free games (Ateş ve Su, Gizli Kelime, Kelime Bulucu, Okey, 101 Okey, Tavla, Balon Patlat, Kelimeler) with live leaderboard highlights and today's daily challenges.
- [Ateş ve Su](https://okutan.org/ates-ve-su/): Free browser two-player co-op puzzle platformer in the fire-and-water style known in Turkey as "Ateş ve Su" (independent original game with its own characters, levels and art). Kor, a glowing ember-rock, walks on lava but dies in water; Damla, a water drop, walks on water but evaporates in lava; purple acid kills both. Pressure plates, two-way levers, elevators, sliding gates and pushable boxes across 100 levels in five worlds (Cave, Crystal, Volcano, Depths, Core); collect gems, beat par time for 3 stars. Two players on one keyboard (arrows / WASD), solo with Tab to switch, touch controls on mobile, or online with a friend on separate devices via invite link with table chat. Installable as a PWA. No sign-up.
- [Gizli Kelime](https://okutan.org/gizli-kelime/): Free browser Turkish word-guessing game in the style of Wordle (independent; Wordle is a trademark of The New York Times): find the hidden five-letter Turkish word in six guesses; blue = right letter in the right spot, orange = in the word but elsewhere, gray = not in the word. Daily word (same for everyone, changes at midnight Türkiye time, numbered), unlimited free play, hard mode, streaks, guess distribution and spoiler-free result sharing. Guesses are checked against about 5,500 five-letter words from the Kelimeler dictionary; on-screen Turkish Q keyboard. Installable as a PWA, works offline. No sign-up.
- [Kelime Bulucu](https://okutan.org/kelime-bulucu/): Free Turkish word finder with Turkish Scrabble tile scores: find every word buildable from your letters (wildcards, letters that must appear), pattern search (k?t?p, ka*, *lık), a Wordle helper (green/yellow/gray letters → remaining five-letter words), a "is this a valid word?" check, a Scrabble tile-bag filter and a word of the day. 60,000+ word dictionary from the Kelimeler game; meanings, parts of speech, examples and etymology from Turkish Wiktionary (CC BY-SA). Every word has its own page at https://okutan.org/kelime-bulucu/kelime/<word>/ (ASCII URLs, e.g. /kelime-bulucu/kelime/aralik/) with all meanings, syllables, score, words buildable from its letters, anagrams and similar words. Over 2,000 word lists at https://okutan.org/kelime-bulucu/liste/ (starting/ending with or containing letters, by length, highest-scoring Scrabble words, short words with J/Ğ/F/Ö/V). Also a board solver for Scrabble-style games at https://okutan.org/kelime-bulucu/tahta/ (enter the 15×15 board and your rack; finds the highest-scoring moves with premium squares, cross-words, blanks and the 50-point bingo), an A–Z dictionary index at https://okutan.org/kelime-bulucu/sozluk/, rhyming words and pronunciation audio on word pages. Search runs in the browser; works offline (PWA).
- [Canlı Sohbet](https://okutan.org/sohbet/): Free Turkish live chat with an mIRC feel and a modern interface, no sign-up: pick a nickname (reserved to your browser by a secret key) and talk in fixed channels #genel (general), #okey (Okey and 101 Okey), #tavla, #kart (Batak, King, Pişti) and #kelime (word games). IRC-style timestamped lines with colored nicknames, /nick, /me, /join, /away, /back, /clear commands, Tab nickname completion, user list with moderators marked @, join/leave lines, mention highlight and sound. Pasting an online table invite link from the games turns it into a one-click join card. Moderation: profanity masking, removal of off-site links, rate limits and slow mode, reporting (messages reported from three networks are hidden), moderators and an admin panel. Messages are kept 30 days; no private messages. Built with PHP, MySQL and short polling. Settings include a classic mIRC look (black background, bracketed timestamps, mIRC colors), font size, timestamps, join/leave lines and desktop notifications; also day separators, older-message loading, an emoji picker, typing indicators, pinned messages by moderators weekly game leaderboard badges next to nicknames, avatars with grouped messages, MOD and admin badges, and optional gender (male / female / prefer not to say) that sets the nickname color (blue / pink / green). Online game lobbies have a "Sohbette duyur" (announce in chat) button that drops the invite into the matching channel. Installable as a PWA.
- [Tavla](https://okutan.org/tavla/): Free browser Turkish backgammon (tavla): hitting, bar entry, bearing off, gammon (mars) scores 2, matches to 3, 5 or 7 points, no doubling cube. Easy, medium and hard bots (hard bot counts hit probabilities over all 36 rolls), online table with a friend via invite link with table chat, click/drag/double-click moves, undo, hints, move timer, leaderboard and profiles. Installable as a PWA. No sign-up.
- [Okey](https://okutan.org/okey/): Free browser classic Turkish Okey (rummy-style tile game): 14 tiles, indicator and okey jokers, runs incl. 12-13-1, sets, seven-pairs finish, point game (normal finish 2, okey discard 4, pairs 4, pairs+okey 8, indicator 1). Three bot levels, daily hand, online tables with friends via invite link, hints, move timer, leaderboard and profiles. Installable as a PWA. No sign-up.
- [Batak](https://okutan.org/batak/): Free browser İhaleli Batak (Turkish auction trick-taking card game, similar to Spades): 4 players, 13 cards each, bidding 4–13, the winning bidder picks trumps and leads; must follow suit and overtake when possible, must trump when void, trumps cannot be led until broken. Scoring: bidder who makes the bid scores tricks taken, otherwise loses the bid; others score their tricks. Three bot levels, daily hand, online tables with friends via invite link and table chat, hints, move timer, leaderboard and profiles. Installable as a PWA. No sign-up.
- [Pişti](https://okutan.org/pisti/): Free browser Turkish Pişti (a fishing card game): 2 players head to head or 4 players in partnerships; 4 cards each and 4 on the table (3 face down); take the pile with a matching rank or a jack; matching a single card is a pişti (10 points), a jack on a single jack is a jack pişti (20). Card points: each ace and jack 1, two of clubs 2, ten of diamonds 3, most cards 3; play to 51, 101 or 151. Three bot levels (the hard bot counts cards), daily hand, online tables with friends and table chat, hints, move timer, leaderboard. Installable as a PWA. No sign-up.
- [King](https://okutan.org/king/): Free browser Turkish King (a trick-taking card game of contracts): 4 players, 13 cards; each hand the chooser picks one of six penalty contracts — no tricks (−50 each), no hearts (−30 each), no kings and jacks (−60 each), no queens (−100 each), last two tricks (−180 each), Rıfkı / king of hearts (−320) — or trumps (+50 per trick). Full game is 20 hands (everyone picks 2 trumps and 3 penalties, each penalty played twice) or a 10-hand short game; scores sum to zero. Must follow suit, must trump in trumps, must dump penalty cards when void, hearts cannot be led until broken. Three bot levels, score sheet, daily hand, online tables with friends and table chat, hints, move timer, leaderboard. Installable as a PWA. No sign-up.
- [101 Okey](https://okutan.org/101-okey/): Free browser 101 Okey (Turkish tile game) with classic coffeehouse rules: three bot levels, a daily hand (same deal for everyone), online tables with friends via invite link, okey swap, optional house rules (12-13-1, doubling opens, penalty size), hints, move timer, leaderboard and player profiles. Installable as a PWA. No sign-up.
- [Balon Patlat](https://okutan.org/balon/): Free browser bubble shooter game (Turkish/English): classic, 2-minute time attack and a daily puzzle (same board for everyone, one try), daily missions, friend challenges via share links, player profiles and a city leaderboard. Installable as a PWA. Built with HTML5 Canvas, PHP and MySQL.
- [Sebze.net](https://www.sebze.net/): Turkish community for hobby gardening and growing vegetables. Built on XenForo with custom development, including his own image-rating add-on.
- [Kitaplar.org](https://www.kitaplar.org/): Turkish book platform for book discovery, recommendations and a reader community, with search, categories and content management.

## Past work

Android games and apps he previously published on Google Play (no longer available on the store): Kelimeler: Türkçe Bulmaca (multiplayer word game, 4.8★), WOW3: Word Connect, Associations: Kelime Bul, Blokları Patlat, Sidik Yarışı, Ezan Vakti — Namaz & Kıble, Zikirmatik — Tesbih, Photo Recovery: Pro.
